entities.name: Meltem Hocaoğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Meltem Hocaoğlu Akyol is a Turkish karateka competing in the kumite +68 kg division. She is a multiple-time medalist at the World Karate Championships, European Karate Championships, European Games, Islamic Solidarity Games and Mediterranean Games.
